spans.s:
mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं)
Small, little, low, mean, &c.
n. (-ल्लं)
A kind of perfume: see खुर.
E.
खुद to divide, &c. and ल from ला to get, the radical द becomes ल.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Low, vile.
2 Little, small.
2 Poor, indigent.
4 Cruel, harsh.
4 Wicked, mischievous, malignant: see क्षुल्ल.

m. (-तः)
A father's younger brother; also क्षुल्लतात.
